title: Requirements not covered by this code.
officialText:
Requirements necessary for the strength, stability or proper operation of an existing
or proposed mechanical system, or for the public safety, health and general welfare, not specifically covered by this code, s hall be
determined by the commissioner.
SECTION MC 103
DEPARTMENT OF BUILDINGS
